meta.name: Stealing America: Vote by Vote
meta.description: Stealing America: Vote by Voteexamines a bundle of documented cases of election manipulation and irregularities throughout the United States, some that stretch back as far as 1996. The film focuses on voter disfranchisement, the use of electronic voting machines, and voting anomalies such as uncounted ballots, inaccurate final vote tallies, and vote-switching. Through a combination of first-person accounts (including Democratic Sen. Bob Hagan of Ohio, who also witnessed vote-switching firsthand), extensive research and revealing clips from multiple TV news sources, this film investigates the many ‘glitches’ in voting procedures that result in literally millions of votes being potentially lost, miscounted or even deleted.
